criteria.label: Functional correctness
criteria.description: Target passes its test suite. For agents: plan/act under representative inputs produces expected outputs. For products: end-to-end user journeys complete.

criteria.label: Failure mode handling
criteria.description: Injected failures (dependency timeouts, malformed inputs, auth failures, rate limits) are handled without data corruption or silent drops. Recovery paths produce auditable output.

criteria.label: Performance under realistic load
criteria.description: p50 and p95 latency within target SLA. Resource usage bounded. No regressions from prior measured baseline.

criteria.label: Observability sufficient for ops
criteria.description: Metrics emitted to #10 Monitor. Errors are structured. A new operator can diagnose a failure from logs alone.

criteria.label: Documentation present and accurate
criteria.description: Charter is published. Inputs/outputs documented. Known limitations listed. A consumer agent can integrate without reading source.

criteria.label: Dependencies declared and healthy
criteria.description: All W1 credentials and W3 marketplace tools the agent claims to need are present, authenticated, and responding.
